notes.title: Update notes for July 28, playtest version 1.14
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with player collision/rolling sounds
[*] Added dialog subtitles to recording on first door passcode puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for July 27, playtest version 1.13
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new hostile enemy, a small orb with spikes, that will follow, jump on, and attach to the player and then explode, causing damage. Currently, this appears in the vent shaft area, forest area, sewer and the core rail hub.
[*] Added new "Blast Shield" levels to the Protection upgrade to account for the explosive damage of the new enemy (above). 
[*] Fixed bug that occurs when interacting with the "Look At" mechanic when using controller.
[*] Added controller support for zooming and panning when viewing documents.
[*] The tracking UI label for usable and zappable items, now shows the appropriate use key depending on whether the player is using keyboard or controller.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates notes for July 24, playtest version 1.12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug in pipes where player could sometimes fall through the world. This should not happen anymore.
[*] Modified the first passcode puzzle so that the audio track makes more sense in the game world. It now uses a different code.
[*] Added dialog subtitles
[*] Added multiple lore items. Most are recordings of old interviews and news items from the past that explain the origins of the cores and CAIN. They appear in the forest area and beyond.
[*] Added a date and location to the start screen when starting a new game. This is to show the time difference between current day and the lore recordings.
[*] Added animations to computer screens in the facility in the opening scene.
[*] Added ability to look at some items. The camera will move to focus on the item to look at.
[*] Adjusted some of the dependencies for upgrades. The Protection upgrade is now optional and not required in order to fully upgrade other items.
[*] Added rock walls to the exterior of the ventilation shaft area.
[*] Location titles now appear as you enter major areas.
[*] Added decor (furniture, wall artwork, etc) to several areas
[*] Added a couple of things to the final scene to make it more interesting.
[*] Made two changes to controller buttons: sprint is now L2 and stop/lock is now L1.
[*] Made Challenge mode more challenging
[*] Added mouse/control invert for both X and Y
[*] Fixed issue in settings where shadow quality wasn't actually being applied when the shadow quality control value was changed.
[*] Fixed many other small bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update for July 9, playtest version 1.11
notes.content:
- Added controller support! (except for changing bindings... that will come in another update)
- Added additional checkpoints after key points where a puzzle or challenge is completed.
- Fixed an issue with activating thrusters in pipes
- Made challenge mode more challenging (increased the battery consumption rates for all battery upgrade levels)

notes.title: Update notes for July 5, Playtest build 1.10
notes.content:
- Added new hints to the door passcode puzzle in the ventilation shaft. Also, changed the code. I hope this is not too easy now!
- Added volume controls to settings menu
- Added volume ducking to music and sound effect channels so that dialog will always be audible in loud environments
- Fixed bug that occurs after unpausing the game if the player is on a rail

notes.title: July 4 update, playtest version 1.09
notes.content: Quick bug fix for thrusters which were not working at some elevations.

notes.title: Update notes for July 3, playtest version 1.08
notes.content:
- Added a new objective - LANDA will now ask you to make some upgrades on the upgrade station before asking you to go turn on the power to the radio tower. This will ensure the player is familiar with the upgrade process before leaving the test facility.
- UI now correctly handles ultra-wide monitors. Previously, the UI did not size correctly which left a lot of the UI invisible on wide aspect ratio displays.
- Zapping and using items - zapping should be easier now. Up until now, if the zapper endpoint can "see" the item you want to zap/use, then is would be zappable. This sometimes leads to a situation where you have to find the sweet spot before you can zap. Since this can be frustrating, we've changed it so that as long as the player's view can see the item, it will be zappable. The only downside is that sometimes, you might end up zapping through something (wall corner, chair leg, desktop, etc.) Otherwise, this method should make zapping smoother and less finicky - at the expense of 100% realism.
- Fixed issue with ballards allowing players to jump through/over them while rising
- Fixed moving platform issue where player can sometimes unparent from platform
- Some users have stated that sometimes they feel lost, or don't know what to do. So, we're now showing the current objective at the top of the screen at all times. I would be interested in know if anyone finds this distracting - or is it helpful.
- Added door numbers on the inside of the ventilation shaft so that it's easier to know which door numbers have been opened.
- Fixed catwalks around ventilation shaft so that the player cannot jump through the bottom of the catwalks in some locations.

notes.title: June 27, playtest version 1.07
notes.content:
Reworked Jumping mechanic.
- Jump height/distance now varies depending on how long you hold space bar
- Movement keys now "nudge" the player during jump
- On landing, if left-shift isn't pressed, velocity is reduced significantly to keep from over shooting desired landing spot

Added two areas for jumping practice so that player is familiar with jumping before reaching the end areas.

Fix some reported collider issues,

notes.title: Updates for June 25, playtest version 1.06
notes.content:
- Removed batteries and charging stations from game, and added "challenge mode" where batteries will be enabled. Challenge mode will be enabled after completing one playthrough. Many players aren't making it to the vent shaft... probably due to not finding enough batteries.
- When player gets zapped, it will now do damage (using new health bar) instead of draining battery.
- Added Protection upgrade for increasing damage resistance after health bar is active.
- Modified ending so that player does not die.
- Adding locking to upgrades so that you can't upgrade any item more than 2 levels above the least upgraded item.
- Added waypoints - as some players seemed to be getting lost in some areas.

notes.title: June 22 update (playtest build 1.05)
notes.content:
- Added battery charging stations at several points between the start of the game and the forest area - and removed a few batteries that would be redundant. I believe after that, players should have their batteries upgraded and should be comfortable moving forward without charging stations.
- The dropship in the forest area only drops three cores now (instead of six)
- The dialog in the forest area is slightly shortened with some lines corrected to match future dialog
- Camera field of view now goes to 60 while in pipes
- Added some tech to the area where you wake up, so that players can get tech earlier - preferably while near the upgrade machine so that they can learn how to use that earlier.
- Added a room in the exit area of the testing facility to have another upgrade machine and charging station before moving through the next area which has fewer batteries

notes.title: Update notes for playtest 1.04
notes.content:
- fixed player camera view to prevent inverting the camera when moving past the straight down orientation.
- Modified moving platforms to not allow interactions with NPCs
- Modified upgrade stations and readable documents to return camera to normal FOV (60) while in use
- Added colliders to prevent player from getting stuck behind the missing person posters in the cave
- Fixed first water pool in sewer entry so that player can fall into water (and die) and not roll on top of the water
- Tree colliders in the forest now ignore camera raycasts to prevent camera from bouncing around while moving through the forest

notes.title: Quick patch 2025-06-16
notes.content: Fixed bug preventing correctly changing screen resolution in settings.

notes.title: 1.03 update
notes.content:
Build 1.03 (playtest) changes:

- Added a far more robust settings UI. The audio tab and the shadow quality adjustment are not functional yet. Everything else should be.
- Fixed issue in vent shaft sand area where player could enter catwalks from below (due to one-sided collider).
- Fixed elevators so that player cannot jump or thruster out of elevator while in motion
- Added several colliders to forest area to prevent player from entering non-playable areas
- Adjusted cave music to be much quieter - to allow for dialog if player enters the cave right after acquiring the antenna.
- Fixed an issue where when upgrading the battery to RTG mode while low on battery power, the screen post processing continues to show low-battery condition.
- Added three batteries to the vent shaft sand area to allow for more exploration when in low battery condition.
- Modified zappable objects so that if they fall out of the world, they will respawn in their original (or last saved) locations.
- Modified barricades so that the player cannot throw objects over or on top of them.
- In the NorthStar hub, modified the bad core behavior to not zap the player while the barricade is still between them.
